item.description:
A break at the press of a button, a better-paced stretch and a tidier menu.

New

  • “Take a break now” in the menu — for instance while the AI is working. A running block counts with the time you actually worked

Improved

  • The stretch has a new pace: a longer chest opening, a shorter head tilt, and calf raises in two calm steps — up and hold, then down
  • A tidier menu: logging is a switch, “Start Timer” has a timer icon, the line under the slider is gone, and so is the gap when logging is off
  • From this version on, updates are signed with a new key — nothing changes for you, and future updates arrive as usual

Fixed

  • In the neck stretch, the base of the neck now stays put on the shoulders instead of sliding sideways
